The sportswear giant plans to unveil a version of its Ultrafly trail running shoe - branded under its outdoor sub-brand, ACG - at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc, an ultramarathon in France that kicks off events on Monday, Nike spokesman Jay Paavonpera said. It is part of Nike's push to reposition ACG as a serious player in performance trail running.
